slices.focus: The denial-reduction pilot expands network-wide with site-specific binders and standardized huddles.
slices.summary: Kelli's denial-reduction pilot expands to the entire network after one clinic's front-desk overtime drop gave Monica proof in plain English. She creates site-specific binders (top five preventable denial causes per clinic) and faces pushback from a physician who sees the pre-bill pause as a flow problem. She defines reporting consistency and a standard huddle format as the backbone of the rollout.
